scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate source CCSD triples-driver fourth/fifth-order energy contributions over virtual orbital pairs and occupied triples
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Four rational polynomial energy contributions per (b,c) virtual pair, reduce over all pairs, then accumulate emp4/emp5 including k terms only when i!=k
scientific_intent.discretization: ncor0,nocc3,nvir33; all18ordered occupied(i,j,k<=i) combinations and3signed deterministic dyadic tensor fixtures
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All216 partial scalar energies and6 final emp4/emp5 values, finite and within1e-10+1e-12relative dualGPU tolerance, sourceCPU and256-bit BigFloat evaluation; scaling/zero-t1 identities
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 54full energy kernels per batch, 16x16 blocks and3x3grid including partial virtual-orbital blocks,10repeated accumulations normalized outside timer
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 orbital denominators bounded away from zero, signed polynomial terms and nondeterministic atomic reduction order. BigFloat equations and independent polynomial scaling identities separate arithmetic/reduction drift from mathematical structure.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Electronic-structure coupled-cluster triples energy microkernel; source explicitly identifies CCSD driver. Not a complete chemistry calculation, molecular dataset, or production convergence study.
scientific_intent.description: Full source energy-operator equations and all occupied-triple combinations for the named dimensions, with every four-component reduction exposed before final conditional energy accumulation. Source native CUB reduction differs existing genuine CUDA.jl per-pair atomics.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native ccsd_tengy.cu/reference.h and existing CUDA.jl implement matching equations. README recommends much larger occupied/virtual regimes; current small named fixture is not production coverage. Main reports DGEMM operation estimates but this actual source does not execute DGEMM; no DGEMM performance attribution.

native_to_julia_mapping.reason: 16x16virtual-pair ownership and full equations matched, but native four CUB block reductions/4atomics perblock versus all Julia four atomics pervalid pair without shared reduction. CUDA.jl original kernel body preserved; KA/JACC reuse copied equation body, not independently rebuilt mathematical formulations.
